text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono has suffered an injury, so
I bring
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... I guess I didn't warm
up
properly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... But please don't look so
sad.
choice_data_list: そんなことはない、しっかりできてたぞ
そんなことはない、しっかりできてたよ

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing! And I always feel better
after
having some chanko, so I'll be
okay! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: それでも休んでほしい

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I guess you can't help but worry
about me.
Okay, then. I will!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go have some chanko! I bet I'll
recover
even faster if we have some
together. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, Hishi Akebono rests up
properly and
starts preparing for our
next training session.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I must've strained myself a little
too
hard...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I knew she was worse off than she let
on... We get
her treated that same day,
then pause her
workouts for a while
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Watch this! These legs I've trained up
with my
sumo stomping aren't just for
show!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting treated, Hishi Akebono
gets right
back into her training with all
guns blazing.
